build.buildCommand: cd ../.. 2>/dev/null || true; corepack enable 2>/dev/null || true; corepack prepare pnpm@8.15.9 --activate 2>/dev/null || true; if [ -f pnpm-workspace.yaml ]; then pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile && pnpm turbo run build --filter=web-main; elif [ -f ../../pnpm-workspace.yaml ]; then cd ../.. && pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile && pnpm turbo run build --filter=web-main; else pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile && pnpm run build; fi; APP=apps/web-main; [ -f .next/standalone/server.js ] && APP=.; mkdir -p $APP/.next/standalone/public $APP/.next/standalone/.next/static; cp -r ${APP#./}/public/. $APP/.next/standalone/public/ 2>/dev/null || cp -r public/. .next/standalone/public/ 2>/dev/null || true; cp -r ${APP#./}/.next/static/. $APP/.next/standalone/.next/static/ 2>/dev/null || cp -r .next/static/. .next/standalone/.next/static/ 2>/dev/null || true

deploy.startCommand: sh -c "export NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=$SUPABASE_URL NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=$SUPABASE_ANON_KEY HOSTNAME=0.0.0.0; SERVER=$(find /app -path '*/.next/standalone*server.js' -print -quit); if [ -z \"$SERVER\" ]; then echo 'standalone server.js not found'; find /app -maxdepth 5 -type d -name standalone -print; exit 1; fi; echo Starting $SERVER; cd $(dirname $SERVER); exec node $SERVER"
